# JD Supra

> > JD Supra is a legal knowledge platform featuring attorney insights, firm publications, and recognition programs including the Readers Choice Awards for legal excellence.

JD Supra serves as a hub for legal content distribution and professional recognition, connecting law firms and attorneys with readers seeking expertise across practice areas. The platform highlights leading practitioners and firms through community-driven awards and rankings.
